name: update_support_ticket
description: Change an existing ticket. The three fields are independent operations and at least one must be supplied: status moves the ticket's state, priority re-ranks it, and note appends to its note history. A closed ticket cannot be changed.

note.description: Text appended to the ticket's note history.

priority.description: New priority, up to and including critical for escalations that page an on-call responder.

error_returns.when: No ticket exists with the given ticket_id.
None of status, note or priority was supplied, or a supplied status or priority is not an accepted value.
